terms.comment: Seneca’s line on the good player (Ben. II 17, 4) is quoted in Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae.

phrases.latin: necesse est autem lūsor bonus aliter illam conlūsōrī longō, aliter brevī mittat
phrases.english: a good player must throw the ball one way to a tall partner and another way to a short one

sources: Lewis & Short: lusor · Lewis & Short: collusor

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
